headline.purpose: The page title in every PageHeader; one per page.

body.purpose: Everything else, including table cells; 15px inside the wiki editor.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, captions, seal text.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, autocomplete lists, dialogs. Nothing in the page flow.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Hover fills and focus rings; reduced motion removes transitions.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: The sidebar becomes a drawer below this width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1b2a4a; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; min-height: 32px; font: 500 14px/1.3 'Public Sans', 'Noto Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #101a30; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b2a4a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions next to the primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #14213d; border: 1px solid #c6ccd6; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; min-height: 32px; font: 500 14px/1.3 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eef1f5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b2a4a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Action
components.description: Icon-only action with a tooltip and an accessible name; rows show up to two, the rest go in a ⋮ menu.

components.css: .ds-icon-action { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #5b6475; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-action:hover { background: #eef1f5; color: #14213d; } .ds-icon-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b2a4a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Seal
components.description: A stamped decision: cinnabar for decided (Approved), ink for proposed or pending.
components.css: .ds-seal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; color: #c2410c; font: 600 12px/1 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seal-ink { color: #1b2a4a; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Outlined field with its label above (static forms) or in the top border (interactive forms).
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; font: 500 12px/1.4 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #14213d; } .ds-field input { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #c6ccd6; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #14213d; background: #fff; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #5b6475; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b2a4a; outline-offset: 0; border-color: #1b2a4a; }

components.name: Side Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar item; the active one gets the ledger fill, 600 weight and an ink icon.

narrative.overview: Athar is where a company's knowledge is written down and its decisions are approved. The interface behaves like a well-run modern records office: calm ink on cool white, ruled ledgers that are easy to scan, plain forms with labels, and a small cinnabar seal wherever something has been approved, proposed or shadowed. The system is compact: 14px body, 20px page titles, dense rows, and icon actions with tooltips. Arabic and English are equal.
keyCharacteristics: Ink navy and cool white, with cinnabar reserved for seals.
Ledger tables: hairline rules, sortable columns, icon row actions and a ⋮ menu.
A left sidebar for navigation; a quiet 56px top bar for search, notifications and the account.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; shadows only on floating layers.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar appears only on decision seals, counts and the mark, under 5% of any screen. A cinnabar button or scope label is a bug.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: There is one action color. Primary, links and focus all use ink navy; nothing else competes.

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Only five sizes exist (plus 15px reading text inside the editor).

rules.name: The No-Caps Rule
rules.body: Buttons, tabs and navigation use sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Cards, tables and panels have no shadow; only floating layers get the floating shadow.

dos: Do build every page from the shared controls: PageHeader, DataTable, RowActions, IconAction, ScopeChip, CommentItem, FormField, EmptyState.
Do keep page titles at 20px and body text at 14px.
Do give every icon-only control a tooltip and an accessible name.
Do make every table column sortable unless sorting is meaningless for it.
Do check every screen in Arabic (RTL) as well as English.
donts: Don't use cinnabar for buttons, links or body text (The Seal Rule).
Don't put primary navigation in the top bar or use uppercase labels.
Don't put text buttons in table rows; use icon actions and the ⋮ menu.
Don't add shadows to cards, tables or panels.
Don't use underlined (Material "text" variant) inputs; fields are outlined.
Don't bring back the teal app bar or the Material heading sizes.
